options.content: TRUFFLES is intermittently online. No alert is raised merely because it sleeps or shuts down. Panels use the verified Windows exporter and streaming collector metric contract with `instance="TRUFFLES"` and `role="streaming-laptop"`. Custom GPU and OBS values disappear when collection is unsuccessful or the collector heartbeat is older than 45 seconds. Stream-quality panels also require an active stream.

panels.title: Collector Health
panels.description: The last remote Windows scrape result forwarded by Alloy. No data is expected while TRUFFLES is asleep or powered off.

targets.expr: up{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} and on(instance, role) ((time() - timestamp(up{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"})) < 45)
100 * (1 - avg(rate(windows_cpu_time_total{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop",mode="idle"}[5m])))
100 * (1 - windows_memory_available_bytes{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} / windows_memory_physical_total_bytes{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"})
100 * avg by (mode) (rate(windows_cpu_time_total{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}[5m]))
windows_memory_available_bytes{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}
windows_memory_physical_total_bytes{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}
100 * (1 - windows_logical_disk_free_bytes{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} / windows_logical_disk_size_bytes{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"})
rate(windows_net_bytes_received_total{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}[5m])
rate(windows_net_bytes_sent_total{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}[5m])

panels.title: Custom Collector Age
panels.description: Custom GPU/OBS panels disappear when this heartbeat is 45 seconds old or either collector reports failure.

targets.expr: time() - streaming_collector_timestamp_seconds{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}

streaming_gpu_utilization_ratio{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} * 100 and on(instance, role) ((time() - streaming_collector_timestamp_seconds{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}) < 45) and on(instance, role) (streaming_gpu_collection_success{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} == 1)

streaming_gpu_encoder_utilization_ratio{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} * 100 and on(instance, role) ((time() - streaming_collector_timestamp_seconds{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}) < 45) and on(instance, role) (streaming_gpu_collection_success{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} == 1)

100 * streaming_gpu_memory_used_bytes{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} / streaming_gpu_memory_total_bytes{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} and on(instance, role) ((time() - streaming_collector_timestamp_seconds{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}) < 45) and on(instance, role) (streaming_gpu_collection_success{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} == 1)

streaming_gpu_temperature_celsius{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} and on(instance, role) ((time() - streaming_collector_timestamp_seconds{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}) < 45) and on(instance, role) (streaming_gpu_collection_success{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} == 1)

streaming_gpu_power_watts{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} and on(instance, role) ((time() - streaming_collector_timestamp_seconds{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}) < 45) and on(instance, role) (streaming_gpu_collection_success{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} == 1)

streaming_obs_fps{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} and on(instance, role) ((time() - streaming_collector_timestamp_seconds{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}) < 45) and on(instance, role) (streaming_obs_collection_success{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} == 1)

streaming_obs_render_time_seconds{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} and on(instance, role) ((time() - streaming_collector_timestamp_seconds{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}) < 45) and on(instance, role) (streaming_obs_collection_success{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} == 1)

streaming_obs_stream_active{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} and on(instance, role) ((time() - streaming_collector_timestamp_seconds{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}) < 45) and on(instance, role) (streaming_obs_collection_success{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} == 1)

streaming_obs_record_active{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} and on(instance, role) ((time() - streaming_collector_timestamp_seconds{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}) < 45) and on(instance, role) (streaming_obs_collection_success{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} == 1)

streaming_obs_reconnecting{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} and on(instance, role) ((time() - streaming_collector_timestamp_seconds{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}) < 45) and on(instance, role) (streaming_obs_collection_success{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} == 1)

panels.title: Active Stream Quality Loss
panels.description: Shown only while OBS reports an active stream with a fresh successful collection. Counters may reset when OBS or an output restarts; encode counters may include recording work.

targets.expr: 100 * rate(streaming_obs_render_skipped_frames_total{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}[5m]) / clamp_min(rate(streaming_obs_render_frames_total{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}[5m]), 0.001) and on(instance, role) (streaming_obs_stream_active{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} == 1) and on(instance, role) (streaming_obs_collection_success{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} == 1) and on(instance, role) ((time() - streaming_collector_timestamp_seconds{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}) < 45)

100 * rate(streaming_obs_encode_skipped_frames_total{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}[5m]) / clamp_min(rate(streaming_obs_encode_frames_total{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}[5m]), 0.001) and on(instance, role) (streaming_obs_stream_active{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} == 1) and on(instance, role) (streaming_obs_collection_success{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} == 1) and on(instance, role) ((time() - streaming_collector_timestamp_seconds{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}) < 45)

100 * rate(streaming_obs_network_dropped_frames_total{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}[5m]) / clamp_min(rate(streaming_obs_stream_frames_total{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}[5m]), 0.001) and on(instance, role) (streaming_obs_stream_active{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} == 1) and on(instance, role) (streaming_obs_collection_success{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} == 1) and on(instance, role) ((time() - streaming_collector_timestamp_seconds{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}) < 45)

streaming_obs_congestion_ratio{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} * 100 and on(instance, role) (streaming_obs_stream_active{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} == 1) and on(instance, role) (streaming_obs_collection_success{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"} == 1) and on(instance, role) ((time() - streaming_collector_timestamp_seconds{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop"}) < 45)

panels.title: OBS and VTubeControl CPU Cores
panels.description: Sum of per-process CPU time rates. Values are CPU cores consumed, not host-normalized percent.

targets.expr: sum by (process) (rate(windows_process_cpu_time_total{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop",process=~"obs64|VTubeControl"}[5m]))

defaults.noValue: PROCESS NOT RUNNING / NO RECENT DATA

panels.title: OBS and VTubeControl Private Working Set

targets.expr: sum by (process) (windows_process_working_set_private_bytes{instance="TRUFFLES",role="streaming-laptop",process=~"obs64|VTubeControl"})

defaults.noValue: PROCESS NOT RUNNING / NO RECENT DATA
